assumptions.claim: All WebSocket CDP connection paths converge on CdpClient::connect_with_headers.
assumptions.evidence: BrowserManager::connect_cdp_inner resolves the URL then delegates to connect_with_headers for direct, provider, and normal CDP connections.

assumptions.claim: Inserting one slash before a query is sufficient and must not parse-reserialize the URL.
assumptions.evidence: The real handshake server observes the required slash and exact encoded query bytes.

assumptions.claim: AGENT_BROWSER_CDP identifies the daemon auto-launch path as a CDP connection attempt.
assumptions.evidence: auto_launch reads the same environment variable and dispatches BrowserManager::connect_cdp; execute_command boundary coverage confirms the resulting message.

side_effects.evidence: The changed production path emits a WebSocket upgrade request to an external CDP endpoint; it creates no durable local state.

commit_points.effect: A WebSocket upgrade request with the normalized request-target is accepted by the endpoint.
